🍓

KRubus ARM64 Repository

Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 13 Trixie) & KDE Plasma 6 package repository compiled with Cortex-A76 microarchitecture tuning for Raspberry Pi 5 and Compute Module 5.

Suite: trixie Component: main Arch: arm64 & all Packages: 1894 Pool Size: 845.2 MB Updated: 2026-11-10 11:00 UTC
🚀 Quick Setup Instructions
# 1. Download and install KRubus GPG keyring
sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSL https://gamingtux.github.io/KRubus/krubus.gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/krubus.gpg

# 2. Add KRubus APT repository source
echo "deb [arch=arm64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/krubus.gpg] https://gamingtux.github.io/KRubus trixie main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/krubus.list

# 3. Update package index
sudo apt update
